title: Detection on the finite integral generator
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l, a scheme T and level n with finite quotient coefficient ring, and ANY module sheaf M over the intrinsic finite ring sheaf, precomposition by single(finiteQuotient), after exact forgetting of coefficients, is injective on Hom(single(evaluated regular coefficient),single(M)[2]). All maps are the concrete maps of [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. No projective-line structure, Chern data, finite generation of M, or invertibility on T is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), second equality and injective-module argument

proof.text: Evaluation at one identifies maps out of the regular coefficient module with global sections. The evaluation/regular-module identification is identity on every section. The unique generator formula for finiteQuotient makes the degree-zero integral comparison exactly this bijection.

Lift hom universes using ULiftHom. The induced equivalences of ringed sites preserve injectivity and evaluation. Apply the injective-module abelian acyclicity theorem on the lifted site, then transfer its right-derived evaluation vanishing back. The mixed-universe Grothendieck theorem supplies enough injectives without changing the abelian structure.

For a general exact additive functor with this degree-zero generator bijection and these acyclic images of injectives, embed the target into an injective and take its cokernel. Naturality of Ext composition and of exact-functor connecting classes gives the square of two right-exact sequences. Induction and the cokernel form of the five lemma prove the comparison bijective in every degree.
Use Ext.homEquiv and the explicit exact-functor single/shift formula to identify the degree-two comparison with the displayed function. Its injectivity is the claim.

theorem finiteQuotient_detects_derived_arrows (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (SemilinearSections.ring.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T n))) :
    Function.Injective (fun a :
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (coefficient T (Arings l E T))) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ↦
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).map (finiteQuotient l E T n) ≫
        mapSingleArrow (finiteForget l E T n) (2 : ℤ) a)
